content: All individuals diagnosed with diabetes, particularly those who are at an elevated risk of complications, must be provided with thorough and detailed education regarding foot care. This education should encompass instructions on how to properly care for their feet, the ability to identify potential foot-related problems, and the importance of conducting routine self-examinations of their feet. While education is a critical component of diabetes management, it is often overlooked; therefore, it is imperative that this information is reinforced on a regular basis. Patients who have been newly diagnosed with diabetes, as well as those who are identified as having high-risk conditions, should receive tailored and specific guidance on this topic.
